test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is '**about**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'India is home to Asia's oldest bamboo'. • In the second filler, the most appropriate preposition is '**about**'. • It means 'a little more or less than; approximately'. (लगभग) • *Example: It’s **about** three kilometers from here to the city.* • Let's look at the meaning of other options: • **on**: in a place or position. (किसी स्‍थान या स्थिति में, पर) • **off**: down or away from a place or a position on something. (किसी स्‍थान या वस्‍तु की स्थिति से नीचे, दूर या परे) • **upon**: more formal term for on, especially in abstract senses. (On के लिए अधिक औपचारिक शब्द, विशेष रूप से अमूर्त इंद्रियों में) **Correct Passage:__** *With over 49,000 plant species reported as of 2018, India holds **about** 11.5% of all the flora in the world. Now, a new fossil record has (3) ______ that India is the birthplace of Asian bamboo, and they (4) ______ formed about 25 million years ago in the north-eastern (5) ______ of the country.* 54:Tb63, The correct answer is '**shown**'.
